items.title: EU Commission opens feedback on draft AI Act fundamental rights impact assessment template
items.summary: The European Commission published a draft template and explanatory notice for the fundamental rights impact assessment (FRIA) under Article 27 of the AI Act. The AI Office developed it with input from the EU Agency for Fundamental Rights. Deployers of high-risk AI systems must notify the results to their market surveillance authority. Public feedback is open until 15 January 2027. Deployers can volunteer by 4 December 2026 to test the draft. The obligation applies from 2 December 2027.
items.why_it_matters: First concrete tool showing EEA firms and public bodies deploying high-risk AI how to document fundamental rights impacts.

items.title: UK ICO call for evidence on data protection and agentic AI closes
items.summary: The UK ICO call for evidence on applying data protection law to agentic AI closed on 20 November 2026. It opened on 8 October 2026. It creates no new duties; ICO will use responses to decide where to add clarity before final guidance.

sources.name: Beyond Horizons, AI law and regulation roundup, November 2026

items.why_it_matters: Signals how UK regulators will treat autonomous AI agents under data protection law.
